online: Cloud configured; sync availability may vary
jsRequired: This research collection requires a modern browser with JavaScript, IndexedDB, and a secure HTTPS connection. The V5 inference demo remains available without joining the study.
securityNotice: This is a research prototype, not a medical device. Drawing patterns and self-reported health information are sensitive research data; collection remains disabled until project configuration, contact details, and security rules are deployed.
protocolIntro: Complete each task at your own pace. Raw pointer events are captured locally for this research session. You may redo or skip any task.
taskSaved: Task saved locally in this browser.
pointerPrompt: Use one continuous stroke where possible. Your raw pointer coordinates are stored only after consent.
task1Prompt: Draw from the center outward for approximately three turns, without lifting if comfortable. Use the reference as a guide; do not treat it as a clinical test.
task2Prompt: Trace the faint spiral template at a comfortable pace. Stay close to the guide when practical.
task3Prompt: Draw one horizontal line from left to right. The on-screen length approximates 10 cm using CSS pixels and is not physically calibrated.
task4Prompt: Trace the wave from left to right in one smooth movement, following the faint guide. This exploratory task is inspired by smooth-pursuit paradigms, not a clinical assessment.
task5PromptEn: Write “elephant” in your usual handwriting, at a comfortable size. This supports handwriting-size research; the current model is not a micrographia-specific detector.
task5PromptVi: Write “con voi” in your usual handwriting, at a comfortable size.
task6Prompt: Draw ten small circles as quickly and comfortably as you can. Stop if you feel discomfort.
feedbackIntro: All required fields are used to describe research context. Do not enter names, contact details, or other directly identifying information.
healthHealthy: I am healthy, no known neurological conditions
healthParkinsons: I have been clinically diagnosed with Parkinson's Disease
healthOther: I have been diagnosed with another neurological condition
yearsHelp: Enter completed years; approximate values are acceptable.
hy2: Stage 2 — bilateral involvement, no balance impairment
hy3: Stage 3 — mild to moderate bilateral disease, some postural instability
hy4: Stage 4 — severe disability, still able to walk or stand unassisted
hy5: Stage 5 — wheelchair-bound or bedridden unless aided
medications: Current Parkinson's medications (select all that apply)
dominantHandUsed: Did you draw with your dominant hand?
tremorConditions: Known tremor conditions (select all that apply)
caffeine: Caffeine consumed in the last 2 hours?
alcohol: Alcohol consumed in the last 4 hours?
queueNotice: Your submission is saved in this browser's IndexedDB queue and will retry when a configured service is online. Browser storage can be cleared or unavailable; no browser-only system can guarantee zero loss.
submissionDone: Session queued locally. You can close this page; synchronization will retry when available.
clearPending: Withdraw and clear unsent local data
faqA1: No. NeuroTrace is a research prototype and cannot diagnose, rule out, or monitor a medical condition. Do not use results to make health decisions.
faqA2: With your consent: pointer trajectories, device/browser measurements, your selected survey answers, a random device identifier, and a salted-by-context SHA-256 fingerprint derived from screen size, browser user agent, and timezone. This is pseudonymous, not guaranteed anonymous.
faqA3: Yes. Each drawing task has an accessible skip control, and the skipped state is included in the research session.
faqA4: Use the research contact listed in the Privacy Policy. A valid project contact must be configured before cloud collection is enabled. Unsent records can be cleared from the transparency controls below.
faqQ5: Is data sent while Firebase is unconfigured?
faqA5: No. The collector displays an offline badge and keeps consented submissions in local IndexedDB until a project is deliberately configured.
confirmReset: Reset the local device identifier for future sessions? Queued or already submitted records will keep their existing identifier.
confirmClear: Permanently clear all unsent local drafts and submissions from this browser? This cannot delete records already synchronized to the research project.
savedOffline: Saved locally; Firebase is not configured.
syncFailed: Some items remain queued. They will retry with exponential backoff.
analyticsDisclaimer: Optional Firebase Analytics is initialized only after consent and is limited to general app-use events; it is not given drawing trajectories or survey answers.
validationMedication: Select at least one medication response, including Prefer not to say.
validationTremor: Select at least one tremor response.
validationOther: Complete the selected Other detail or change the selection.
inferenceUnavailable: V5 inference unavailable for this task
privacyDraft: Unconfigured build: internal QA only, not participant recruitment. Controller, contact, Firebase project and security rules must be completed before the study launches; cloud sync is offline.
consentClarification: The word “anonymous” in the drawing-data consent means direct identifiers are not requested; device identifiers are pseudonymous and may be linkable. See the Privacy Policy.
consentIntro: Please read the policies below. Consent is required before any drawing task begins. You may close this dialog without participating.
consentAdult: I confirm I am 18 years or older.
consentTerms: I have read and agree to the Privacy Policy and Terms.
consentDonation: I consent to anonymous donation of my drawing data for Parkinson's AI research.
consentNoDiagnosis: I understand this is NOT a medical diagnosis.
preparingConsent: Preparing local consent and identity records…
taskSkippedStatus: Task saved locally and marked as skipped.
